id.description: Event identity, unique per (subscription, sender): 1..128 characters, no control characters. It is rendered verbatim into the injected block and joined into the dedup key, so a NUL would let two events collide.

sender.description: The channel a reply goes to: 1..512 characters, no control characters. Rendered verbatim into the injected block header, so a newline would forge a header line; never an authorization credential.

sessionId.description: Sender's session/instance identifier (RFC §5.4): opaque, unstable across sessions, never an authorization credential.

senderDescription.description: Sender-supplied, display-only note about where it runs (agent, session, cwd, host, ip, platform, pid); never an authorization.

body.description: The event body, injected into the agent context whole: at most 64 KiB (the validator counts JS string length). Large payloads belong in a stored file (ace_store_file), with the token sent as the event.
